$comment: The site's static pages: the one list both the client (React Router prerender, client/src/routes.ts) and the server sitemap (server/src/lib/staticRoutes.ts) read, so they cannot drift. Every entry is prerendered, and every entry but / has its own rewrite in render.yaml, so that its no-slash address serves its prerendered page (server/src/blueprint.test.ts fails without it); it is in the sitemap unless it says "sitemap": false, with its reason in "sitemapNote". Dynamic pages (/stories/:slug, /podcast/:id/transcript, /newsletter/:slug) are not here: the server sitemap adds them from the database. /newsletter/archive only redirects to /newsletter (App.tsx), so it is in no list. See .context/seo.md.

routes.sitemapNote: Left out of the sitemap on purpose: a personal page whose saved stories live in the visitor's own browser, so there is nothing to index.
Left out of the sitemap on purpose: the newsletter confirmation page, noindex in every state (its prerendered head included), so there is nothing to index.
